Bounded follow-up at `4479504a108302c8e9ff85d8202938d9344dfc2e` against reviewed14e: root plus independent correctness/test/PM refresh confirms the original irreducible pinned-source finding is repaired in source. Query sizing subtracts source+control, retained-result sizing correctly subtracts control only, and runtime work/output overlap is accounted separately. The new actual-allocation-calibrated guards assert sticky nonretryable terminal failure, zero advancement, exact source release, neighboring sufficient-budget progress and genuine held-view/shared-work retry for Database and read-snapshot paths. Existing build registration is unchanged.

Independently downloaded current Windows run39060992527's artifact12111243396, verified API/ZIP SHA25606d7236816761d4bc0f4e68d38c15cf6e48991ff27fb606cf65951cd149a9b1c and all nine members. Source/engine receipts bind6206ad91 to447; the compare changes only the manual workflow. Actual root output explicitly passes all four new pinned-source guards,32 root cases; executor11+admission7+COW33+source12 gives95/95. This is current repair GREEN evidence, distinct from the predecessor61-file packet. The local semantic RED3PASS/2FAIL and other new-head whole-run/fuzz/capacity claims still need their current published source/log/command packet for independent audit. Complete447 qualification and affected final review remain pending; no approval from partial CI or old14e passes.

We also inspected attached ProcessMemoryPolicy headroom. Under stable externally owned RSS, sizing may repeatedly request a larger batch although a smaller one would fit its current policy; the source trace is concrete. After checking987, the maintained retained contract and the exact interchange proposal, we are **not promoting it to a new blocker**: the available-byte sizing clause needs interpretation alongside the host policy's explicitly retryable/fail-closed external pressure boundary. This is distinct from the fixed, irreducible self-owned query charge. Please clarify the intended RSS-adaptive boundary when publishing qualification; no blanket liveness guarantee or terminal treatment of sampled RSS is inferred here.

This COMMENT closes only the original source-level defect in the bounded repair. The overall changes-request/qualification boundary remains until the current differential packet, complete required gates and affected exact-head review are finished. No reviewer build/test/native execution, foreign/Arrow/full986 resource acceptance, stable Mem activation or merge/deployment claim.
